criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 1, 6, 7 and 8 are real material reliefs; frame 7 is close to the showstopper. Frames 2 and 3 are rows of identical slides whose brightest mass is the mid grey label ends, each section with a glowing sticker outline. Frames 4 and 5 read as a bar chart on black, and frame 5's engraved scale stops at 18 units under a 21-segment bar. Frame 9's label end is flat grey.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One key, one layout, two continuity devices that work, the edge tease from 2 to 3 and 4 to 5 and the T cell motif. Frames 2 to 5 leave the warm tissue world for four frames of cold grey hardware.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the drawn counts match. Points off for loose wording: absences on frame 9 and in the caption that don't name the release, 'helped fund it' where c12 funds the study, a stale c11 on frame 2, a stale caption in copy.json, and 'four official records' for a release and a journal page.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened and who did it are clear. No place, body, deadline or next step. The only Texas stake is CPRIT as one of five funders, and frame 9 never says who Linghua Wang is.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe; frame 2 is method and the finding waits until frame 7. Frames 4 and 5 could merge. The turn at 7 is real, 8 lands, the close is quiet.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean against house rules, hedges follow the source. Nothing Texan in the register, 'slide' ambiguous on frames 2 and 3, the 4 and 21 hooks are labels rather than lines.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Technique, palette and structure diverge sharply from nos. 49 to 52. The beat is the third health AI deck in thirteen days and the instrument is familiar.

defects_ranked: Frame 5's engraved scale stops at 18 units.
Absences on frame 9 and in the caption don't name the release.
'Helped fund it' where c12 funds the study.
'Four official records' for a release and a journal page.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey segmented bars read as a bar chart, the engraved scale stops at 18 units under the 21 bar, SPACER labels sit ambiguously.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Extend the scale to 21 units, give each bar a hard specular on its upper-left edge, set each SPACER label flush left on its own bar's track.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The tick field reads as graph paper, the steel bar has no bright edge, SPACER sits under the existing approaches block.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Keep one engraved row under the SPACER bar, relight the bars to one bright bevel, move SPACER onto the long bar's track.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Identical slides, mid grey label ends the brightest mass, sections with a sticker outline.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Darken the frosted ends with a lit bevel edge and replace the outline glow with relief height and a thin cast.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The same grid as frame 2 and the count's end not lit enough.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Put the key's pool on the bare bench right of the 37th slide and drop the rest a stop.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The frosted label end near L* 50 and the close's subject small.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise the label to L* 70 to 80, shade the grooves as lit-edged cavities, crop tighter on the aperture.

one_sentence_fix: Merge frames 4 and 5 inside the tissue world and spend the freed frame on a fetched Texas stake.
